scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm calling to check on the status of my loan application. Can you tell me if it has been approved or denied? I submitted it a few weeks ago for a cash-out refinancing under the VA program.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Can you tell me what my interest rate is and the total costs associated with this loan? Also, is there any indication of high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 5.99%. The total costs associated with the loan are $13,673.95. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. I also wanted to know if my loan has been sold to another institution and what my debt-to-income ratio is?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been sold to Ginnie Mae. Your debt-to-income ratio is 46%.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for providing that information. It's been very helpful. I think I have all the information I need.

<Neutral> The agent was polite and provided the information I needed, but I was hoping for a lower interest rate. The process was straightforward, but the rate is higher than I expected.
